note: Seeded distributions until live aggregates exist. Stable per puzzle id. firstGuessWorld and each firstGuessByCountry bucket are one seeded play, so the first real submits replace that ordering. countryBoard is average tries only, about 9 seeded plays per country. Countries under 9 plays are skipped on the leaderboard (seeds count); one or two real plays with no seed stay off it. The board is ranked by fewest tries. standing is a full crowd, a little under a typical clear, so better-than stays stable while real plays mix in. standing.firstOf is the puzzle row count (five slots for Top 5) and avgFirst is on that scale. standing.byTries is finished games; standing.failed is unfinished games, ranked below every finish. Accuracy starts at 100 and drops with each extra try. How far a miss was only moves the score inside that try's band.
